title: Intern to CTO: Taking On a $10B Silicon Valley Giant from Malaysia
description:
Isaac Tan helped build and sell a Malaysian AI data company. The biggest regret? Find out in the podcast!

Ken and Ashvin talk with Isaac Tan Heng Wai, co-founder of SUPA (acquired by TDCX), founding member of Malaysian.ai and co-founder of Kelas Sekejap. Isaac shares the 12-year path from intern to co-founder: a refund crisis, a weekend dog-breed classifier that sparked the pivot into data labeling, and months of sleeping in the car during final year. The three get into how AI training data is really made, why the best product teams build at the edge of what models can do, and why Isaac now builds hyper-local instead of global. It closes with advice for young Malaysians starting out in an AI-shaped job market.

title: The Era of Agents Replacing Humans could finally be here | Malaysian AI Podcast
description:
Visit malaysian.ai for more info on communities and info!

Welcome to  the Malaysian AI Podcast, a series documenting the people, communities and practical work shaping Malaysia's AI future.

Ken and Ashvin discuss what AI agents are and how tool calls let models act through APIs, files, calendars, browsers and other connected systems. They cover the shift from chatbots to personal assistants such as Grokbot, the practical trade-offs of virtual machines, permissions, storage and security, Ken’s AI-assisted podcast editor, and experiments using AI for Blender-based 3D modeling, spatial understanding and robotics.

The conversation shows why building with agents requires more than prompting: creators still need to understand tools, architecture, costs, failure cases and security, especially when an agent can access files, accounts or other systems.

title: 0 to 100k Users in 4 Weeks: How Cleve Got Funded and Went Viral
description:
How do you go from an idea to a funded AI startup in Malaysia, without family money or a big corporate exit?

Welcome to Episode 3 of the Malaysian AI Podcast, a series documenting the people, products and ideas shaping Malaysia's AI future, focusing on actionable ideas you can take away as a builder.

In this episode, Ken sits down with Ashvin Praveen, co-founder of Cleve, to walk through the whole journey: pivoting from a marketing agency to an AI startup, getting into Antler, securing support from Cradle, and launching the free LinkedIn Wrapped campaign that attracted 100,000 users in four weeks.

They also explore customer validation, where startup money actually goes, Cleve's evolution into shared AI memory, and why having fun matters when building a company.

If you're a builder in Malaysia wondering what your next step is—accelerator, grant, VC or bootstrapping—this one's for you.

title: Inside Malaysia's Biggest AI Learn-A-Thon | Malaysian AI Podcast
description:
What happens when 3,500 Malaysians come together to learn and build with AI in Malaysia's Biggest AI Learn-A-Thon?

Welcome to Episode 2 of the Malaysian AI Podcast, a series documenting the people, communities and practical work shaping Malaysia's AI future.

Ken and Ashvin unpack AI Malaysia Takeover 2026: two days of workshops, talks and Malaysia's biggest AI Learn-a-Thon. They discuss why people of every age showed up to build, what a grassroots technology movement needs, how volunteers created the event in only three weeks, what founders learn from community work, and why the same startup playbook rarely works twice.

This is a practical look behind the event: what happened, why it mattered and what it says about Malaysia's appetite for AI.

title: Is the dream of building Malaysia’s AI scene too far fetched?
description:
Should everyone become an AI builder? Ken and Ashvin’s answer might surprise you.

Welcome to the first episode of the Malaysian AI Podcast—a series documenting the people, products and ideas shaping Malaysia’s AI future.

We created this podcast to bring Malaysia’s AI conversations closer to the people actually doing the work. It is a space for builders, founders and curious newcomers to share what they are learning, challenge popular assumptions and help grow Malaysia’s AI application ecosystem.

In this episode, Ken speaks with Ashvin, Co-founder and CEO of Cleve, about Malaysia’s rapidly growing builder community and what it really takes to create with AI.

They discuss how vibe coding changes product creation, whether Malaysia can compete globally, what “training an AI model” actually means, AI access and guardrails—and why AI can make a bad idea ten times worse.

This is not another conversation about AI hype. It is an honest look at what Malaysian builders are doing, where the country’s opportunities lie and which skills will matter next.
